_note: Story portraits (tools/gen_story.py; docs/story.md 'Portraits'). Per speaker: 'art' = an approved portrait-v2 source (assets/story/portraits/<name>.txt: colour keys with their DMG shade, @size up to 56x56, @maxpal <= 3, an 'obj=' key = a CGB-only OBJ accent; the CGB BG palettes, the per-tile palette map and the overlay come from the art itself, converted exactly or the build fails); 'x', 'y' = screen tile of the picture's top-left (the frame takes one tile around it; default: column 2, the frame's bottom on row 12; a picture whose bottom row is 12 stands on the text box, whose top panel is then the frame's bottom). 'variants': name -> {art, from, to}: the speaker's pages from 'from' to 'to' (inclusive, in script order; 'SCENE' or 'SCENE:page', pages counted from 1; 'from' alone: to the end of the game; a scene alone: its first / last page) show that art instead (same x, y); a page given by number must be the speaker's, every variant must be used and two of a speaker's variants may not overlap. NARRATOR has no portrait.
